title: Live Cursors
description: Live Cursors is a collaboration ability in the Multi-User Collaborative Presence Avatars database. Shows every collaborator's cursor with their name attached. Cursor positions stream at 10 Hz and render as labeled carets in each user's color. It takes cursor stream and produces labeled cursors. Tunable parameters: 10 Hz updates. Guarantee: cursors never show passwords or masked fields.

title: Avatar Stacks
description: Avatar Stacks is a collaboration ability in the Multi-User Collaborative Presence Avatars database. Stacks avatars on the element each person is viewing. Viewports are shared as element IDs; the stack renders on the element with a count badge. It takes viewport stream and produces avatar stacks. Tunable parameters: max 5 shown, then +N. Guarantee: stacks never cover the element's content.

title: Status Messages
description: Status Messages is a collaboration ability in the Multi-User Collaborative Presence Avatars database. Lets each user set a short status visible on their avatar. Statuses are 40 characters max and expire after 4 hours unless renewed. It takes user input and produces status badges. Tunable parameters: 40 chars, 4 h TTL. Guarantee: expired statuses always clear themselves.

title: Follow Mode
description: Follow Mode is a collaboration ability in the Multi-User Collaborative Presence Avatars database. Lets one user follow another's viewport exactly. The follower's view mirrors the leader's scroll and zoom until follow is toggled off. It takes leader viewport and produces mirrored view. Tunable parameters: toggle anytime. Guarantee: follow never moves the follower's cursor.

title: Voice Proximity

Distance between avatars scales each voice channel; nearby collaborators sound near. It takes avatar positions and produces distance-attenuated audio. Tunable parameters: falloff 1/d². Guarantee: volume never drops below the audibility floor.
